sections.title: SRN PLAINS NWD INTO WRN SD
sections.text: A CLUSTER OR TWO OF STRONG-SEVERE TSTMS IS EXPECTED TO BE ONGOING AT THE START OF THE PERIOD INVOF THE FRONT IN THE SRN PLAINS AND POSSIBLY POSE A LARGE HAIL/WIND RISK. RICHER LOW LEVEL MOISTURE /MID 50S-MID 60S/ IS EXPECTED TO BE DRAWN INTO THE HIGH PLAINS TO THE S OF ANY MORNING TSTM ACTIVITY WITH THE FOCUS FOR STRONG TO SEVERE TSTMS SHIFTING INTO THIS REGION. A STOUT ELEVATED MIXED LAYER WILL ACT TO SUPPRESS STORM DEVELOPMENT UNTIL AFTERNOON AS STRONG HEATING AND UPSLOPE FLOW OVER NW TX/ERN NM LOCALLY BREACH THE CAP. A VERY UNSTABLE AIRMASS IS FORECAST TO DEVELOP WITH UPWARDS OF 2000-3500 J/KG MLCAPE PER FORECAST SOUNDINGS PRIOR TO CONVECTIVE OVERTURNING IN THE MODEL. MORE THAN ADEQUATE MID-HIGH LEVEL WLY FLOW ATOP A STRONGLY VEERING LOW LEVEL WIND PROFILE WILL SUPPORT ORGANIZED SEVERE STORMS WITH SUPERCELLS THE PREFERRED MODE WITH THE INITIAL DIURNALLY DRIVEN ACTIVITY POSING A LARGE TO VERY LARGE HAIL RISK. AS TEMP/DEWPOINT SPREADS DECREASE BY THE EARLY EVENING AND LCL/S LOWER...AN ATTENDANT ISOLD TORNADO RISK MAY INCREASE. STORM CONSOLIDATION/UPSCALE GROWTH WILL PROBABLY OCCUR BY DARK AS THE ACTIVITY MOVES ESEWD DOWN THE MOISTURE AXIS AND AS THE LLJ INTENSIFIES CONSIDERABLY DU

sections.title: UPPER OH/TN RIVER VALLEYS
sections.text: ALONG AND AHEAD OF THE COLD FRONT...MODERATE INSTABILITY /1000-1500 J/KG MLCAPE/ WILL DEVELOP IN A RELATIVELY NARROW CORRIDOR WITHIN AN ENVELOPE OF 20-30 KT EFFECTIVE SHEAR. ISOLD STRONG TO SEVERE MULTICELLS MAY YIELD AN ATTENDANT HAIL/WIND RISK.

sections.title: DEEP SOUTH
sections.text: SCTD TSTMS WILL DEVELOP MAINLY DURING THE AFTN WITHIN A MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIRMASS AHEAD OF THE COLD FRONT. THE STRONGER STORMS MAY BE CAPABLE OF ISOLD POCKETS OF WIND DAMAGE. ..SMITH/PETERS.. 06/12/2012

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: CONTINUED EWD MOTION OF UPR GRT LKS TROUGH INTO QUE WILL LEAVE LARGELY ZONAL FLOW ACROSS MOST OF THE CONUS AS FLAT RIDGE PERSISTS OVER THE SRN PLNS/WRN GULF OF MEXICO. TWO BANDS OF ENHANCED FLOW IN THE ZONAL CURRENT SHOULD REMAIN MORE OR LESS STNRY THROUGH THE PERIOD...A NRN ONE EXTENDING FROM ID/WY INTO NEB/IA...AND A SRN BRANCH EXTENDING FROM NM INTO THE SRN PLNS/SRN OZARKS. AT LWR LVLS...COLD FRONT ASSOCIATED WITH THE GRT LKS TROUGH WILL MOVE E ACROSS THE UPR OH VLY/APPALACHIANS THIS AFTN/EVE...WHILE ITS WRN EXTENSION BECOMES QSTNRY/DIFFUSE OVER THE LWR MS VLY/SRN PLNS AND LEE TROUGH STRENGTHENS OVER THE HIGH PLNS. NUMEROUS STRONG TO SVR TSTMS ARE EXPECTED THIS PERIOD NOT ONLY ALONG/NEAR QSTNRY FRONT OVER THE SRN PLNS/LWR MS VLY...BUT ALSO ALONG LEE TROUGH OVER THE SRN AND CNTRL HIGH PLNS.

sections.title: SE TX/SRN LA TODAY
sections.text: OVERNIGHT ARKLATEX MCS HAS LEFT AN ELONGATED /W-E/ COLD POOL OVER CNTRL LA THAT MAY SERVE AS THE FOCUS FOR RENEWED STORM DEVELOPMENT THROUGH AT LEAST MIDDAY AS MODEST WSW LOW LVL FLOW AND DEEP EML PERSIST TO ITS SOUTH. THIS SETUP COULD YIELD ADDITIONAL PERIODIC EPISODES OF ENHANCED FORWARD PROPAGATION/BOWING...WITH AN ATTENDANT RISK FOR SVR WIND VIA HIGH PW/WATER LOADING.

sections.title: SRN PLNS/SRN HIGH PLNS THIS AFTN THROUGH TNGT
sections.text: WIDELY SCTD TSTMS NOW OVER W TX/ERN NM ARE ELEVATED ATOP SHALLOW POST-FRONTAL COOL DOME. THEY MAY PERSIST FOR AWHILE THIS MORNING...AND MAY POSE A LOW RISK FOR SVR WIND/HAIL. MEANWHILE...LOW LVL MOISTURE /MID 50S-MID 60S/ WILL CONTINUE TO SPREAD WNW INTO THE SRN HIGH PLNS TODAY AS STALLING FRONT LOSES DEFINITION AND LEE TROUGH STRENGTHENS E OF THE RCKYS. COUPLED WITH SFC HEATING...MOISTURE INFLOW SHOULD YIELD VERY STRONG INSTABILITY...WITH SBCAPE RANGING FROM AROUND 2000 J/KG IN ERN NM TO NEAR 4000 J/KG IN NW TX. DEEP/STRONG EML LIKELY WILL DELAY STORM DEVELOPMENT UNTIL AFTN WHEN COMBINATION OF STRONG HEATING AND UPSLOPE FLOW BREACH THE CAP. 25-30 KT WNWLY 500 MB FLOW ATOP ESELY LOW LVL FLOW SHOULD PROVIDE AMPLE /30-40 KT/ WNWLY DEEP SHEAR FOR SUPERCELLS. THESE STORMS WILL BE CAPABLE OF VERY LARGE HAIL IN ADDITION TO LOCALLY DMGG WIND. THE THREAT FOR TORNADOES MAY INCREASE BY EARLY EVE AS TEMP-DEWPOINT SPREADS AND LCLS DECREASE. THE STORMS LIKELY WILL MERGE INTO A LARGE CLUSTER TOWARD DARK AS THE STORMS MOVE/DEVELOP INTO INCREASINGLY MOIST SELY NEAR-SFC FLOW...SLY LLJ NOCTURNALLY STRENGTHENS...AND SRN BRANCH JET PERSISTS ALOFT. THIS SYSTEM MAY EVOLVE INTO A LARGER SCALE WIND-PRODUC

sections.title: CNTRL HI PLNS
sections.text: A SEPARATE AREA OF ENHANCED SVR THREAT MAY EVOLVE OVER FAR ERN WY AND WRN PORTIONS OF NEB/SD...WHERE UPLIFT WILL BE ENHANCED BY A DISTURBANCE IN NRN STREAM JET. WHILE MOISTURE WILL REMAIN LIMITED RELATIVE TO POINTS FARTHER S...IT SHOULD BE SUFFICIENT FOR WIDELY SCTD TSTMS /INCLUDING SUPERCELLS/ WITH A RISK FOR SVR HAIL/WIND. THESE MAY EVOLVE INTO A SMALL E OR SE-MOVING CLUSTER TNGT.

sections.title: UPR OH/TN VLYS AND WRN APPALACHIANS THIS AFTN
sections.text: ALONG AND AHEAD OF COLD FRONT...MODERATE INSTABILITY /1000-1500 J PER KG MLCAPE/ WILL DEVELOP IN A RELATIVELY NARROW CORRIDOR WHERE STRONGER HEATING WILL OCCUR IN PRESENCE OF 20-30 KT WLY DEEP SHEAR. ISOLD STRONG TO SVR MULTICELLS COULD YIELD LOCALLY SVR HAIL/WIND.

sections.title: SERN STATES THIS AFTN
sections.text: SCTD MAINLY DIURNAL TSTMS EXPECTED WHERE POCKETS OF HEATING OCCUR AHEAD OF STALLING COLD FRONT AND ALONG RESIDUAL OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES FROM YESTERDAYS STORMS. ISOLD STRONGER STORMS MAY YIELD BRIEF/ LOCALLY DMGG WIND. ..CORFIDI/LEITMAN.. 06/12/2012

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: LARGE-SCALE PATTERN WILL UNDERGO SLIGHT DE-AMPLIFICATION DURING THE D1 PERIOD AS PRIMARY UPPER TROUGH MOVES FROM ONTARIO INTO QUEBEC. 12Z UPPER-AIR ANALYSIS DEPICTS A COUPLE OF HIGHER MOMENTUM FLOW CHANNELS IN THE MID TO UPPER-TROPOSPHERE...ONE FROM THE PACIFIC NW THROUGH CNTRL PLAINS INTO GREAT LAKES...AND THE OTHER FROM SRN CA INTO SRN HIGH PLAINS AND S TX. WITHIN THIS BROADER-SCALE PATTERN...WATER VAPOR IMAGERY SHOWS A NUMBER OF WEAK PERTURBATIONS...TWO OF WHICH MAY BE INSTRUMENTAL IN SEVERE TSTM DEVELOPMENT LATER TODAY INTO TONIGHT. THE FIRST IS EMBEDDED WITHIN POLAR BRANCH OF WESTERLIES OVER N-CNTRL WY WHICH WILL TRANSLATE EWD INTO WRN SD BY AFTERNOON. THE OTHER IS A BIT WEAKER AND LOCATED IN SUB-TROPICAL AIR STREAM NEAR THE FOUR CORNERS...WITH THIS FEATURE MOVING INTO THE SRN HIGH PLAINS BY LATE AFTERNOON INTO EVENING. AT THE SURFACE...SEGMENT OF COLD FRONT FROM CENTRAL OH TO MS-OH RIVER CONFLUENCE WILL ADVANCE THROUGH THE LOWER GREAT LAKES AND INTO THE CNTRL APPALACHIANS AND TN VALLEY. THE WRN EXTENSION OF SYNOPTIC FRONT HAS BEEN MASKED BY A NUMBER OF CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES RESIDING ACROSS THE SRN PLAINS WITH A BROAD CONFLUENCE AXIS STRETCHING FROM THE RED RIVER INTO

sections.title: SRN PLAINS
sections.text: TSTMS WHICH INITIATED LATE MONDAY NIGHT OVER NERN NM ARE ONGOING OVER NWRN TX...FORCED BY A WEAK MIDLEVEL IMPULSE AND LOW-LEVEL WAA/ISENTROPIC ASCENT ABOVE SHALLOW OUTFLOW BOUNDARY/FRONT. AIR MASS AHEAD OF THESE STORMS ACROSS N-CNTRL/CNTRL TX SHOULD UNDERGO RAPID DESTABILIZATION TODAY OWING TO THE PRESENCE OF STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES AND AN INCREASINGLY MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER WITH SWD EXTENT INTO CNTRL TX WHERE AFTERNOON MLCAPE WILL APPROACH 2500-3500 J/KG. IN FACT...THERE IS SOME INDICATION IN CONVECTION-ALLOWING AND DETERMINISTIC MESOSCALE MODEL GUIDANCE THAT THESE STORMS COULD GROW UPSCALE INTO A FORWARD-PROPAGATING MCS WITH A DAMAGING WIND AND HAIL THREAT SPREADING SEWD TOWARD THE SABINE RIVER VALLEY AND UPPER TX COAST. OVER THE HIGH PLAINS...OUTFLOW IN THE WAKE OF NWRN TX TSTMS WILL ENHANCE LOW-LEVEL UPSLOPE FLOW COMPONENT...WHICH WHEN COUPLED WITH THE POTENTIAL INFLUENCE OF WEAK FOUR CORNERS IMPULSE...WILL FOSTER WIDELY SCATTERED TSTMS ACROSS PORTIONS OF NERN/E-CNTRL NM INTO WRN TX BY MID-LATE AFTERNOON. AMBIENT ENVIRONMENT WILL BE CHARACTERIZED BY MLCAPE OF 1500-2500 J/KG AND 40-50 KT OF DEEP WLY SHEAR WHICH WILL FAVOR SUPERCELLS AS THE INITIAL STORM MODE WITH AN ASSOCIATED

sections.title: NRN/CNTRL HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: FORCING ASSOCIATED WITH WY IMPULSE WILL AUGMENT LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE ASCENT INVOF LEE CYCLONE AND TROUGH TO GIVE RISE TO WIDELY SCATTERED TSTMS BY MID AFTERNOON FROM WRN SD INTO ERN CO. WHILE THE BOUNDARY LAYER WILL BE LESS MOIST THAN POINTS TO THE SOUTH...STEEP LOW TO MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL YIELD MLCAPE VALUES OF 1000-1500 J/KG IN THE PRESENCE OF 40-50 KT DEEP WNWLY SHEAR. HERE TOO...SUPERCELLS APPEAR LIKELY WITH THE POTENTIAL FOR LARGE HAIL...DAMAGING WINDS...AND PERHAPS A TORNADO.

sections.title: SRN LA
sections.text: THE INFLUX OF A MODERATELY UNSTABLE AND VERY MOIST AIR MASS INTO SWD-PROPAGATING MCS WILL MAINTAIN ROBUST UPDRAFT DEVELOPMENT ALONG LEADING EDGE OF SYSTEM COLD POOL. WHILE SOME LARGE HAIL IS POSSIBLE...DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE THE PRIMARY HAZARD. ...UPPER OH VALLEY/LOWER GREAT LAKES SWD INTO THE CNTRL APPALACHIANS... UPLIFT ALONG COLD FRONT AND DEEPER-LAYER FORCING ASSOCIATED WITH A VORTICITY MAXIMUM MOVING ACROSS THE REGION WILL SUPPORT AN INCREASE IN TSTM ACTIVITY THIS AFTERNOON INTO EVENING. WHILE VERTICAL SHEAR WILL REMAIN SUB-OPTIMAL FOR STORM ORGANIZATION/SUSTENANCE...THE PRESENCE OF A MOIST...MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIR MASS /I.E. MLCAPE VALUES OF 1000-2000 J PER KG/ WILL SUPPORT A FEW VIGOROUS STORMS CAPABLE OF MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL AND LOCALLY STRONG WIND GUSTS INTO THIS EVENING.

sections.title: MID ATLANTIC AND SERN STATES
sections.text: 12Z SOUNDINGS AND SATELLITE-DERIVED PW IMAGERY INDICATE THE PRESENCE OF A VERY MOIST AIR MASS /I.E. PW VALUES OF 1.75-2.00 INCHES/ WHICH WILL CONTRIBUTE TO POCKETS OF MODERATE INSTABILITY BY AFTERNOON. THIS IS ESPECIALLY THE CASE ACROSS PORTIONS OF GA/NRN FL INTO SC WHERE VISIBLE SATELLITE SUGGESTS THE POTENTIAL FOR STRONGER DAYTIME HEATING. A DEVELOPING LEE TROUGH WILL COMBINE WITH EXISTING CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES AND AN MCV OVER THE SAVANNAH RIVER VALLEY TO PROMOTE SCATTERED TSTMS THIS AFTERNOON. VERTICAL SHEAR WILL REMAIN WEAK...BUT THE HIGH MOISTURE CONTENT WILL BE FAVORABLE FOR WET MICROBURST FORMATION OWING TO WATER LOADING EFFECTS. ..MEAD/ROGERS.. 06/12/2012

sections.title: SRN PLAINS
sections.text: TSTMS DVLPG OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN OF SOUTH-CENTRAL CO/NORTH-CENTRAL NM WILL E/SE THROUGH THIS EVENING WITH SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF VERY LARGE HAIL...DAMAGING WINDS...AND ISOLATED TORNADOES. 12Z MESOSCALE MODELS CONTINUE TO SUGGEST THAT THESE STORMS...AS WELL AS ADDITIONAL TSTMS THAT MAY DEVELOP OVER W TX THROUGH EVENING...WILL MERGE INTO ONE OR MORE FORWARD-PROPAGATING SVR MCS/S POSING A DAMAGING WIND THREAT AND MOVE SEWD ACROSS AREAS FROM THE TX PANHANDLE SWD INTO CENTRAL TX OVERNIGHT. TSTMS DEVELOPING NORTH OF MARFA ARE EXPECTED TO FURTHER INTENSIFY IN THE PRESENCE OF 40 KT DEEP LAYER SHEAR AND A MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIR MASS. LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE POSSIBLE.

sections.title: NRN PLAINS
sections.text: REF MCD #1141 FOR SHORT-TERM CONVECTIVE TRENDS ACROSS PORTIONS OF NE CO/WRN NEB/SWRN SD. THINKING ACROSS THE REMAINDER OF THE CONUS IS UNCHANGED FROM PREVIOUS OUTLOOK. ..BUNTING.. 06/12/2012 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1125 AM CDT TUE JUN 12 2012/

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STRONG TO ISOLATED SEVERE STORMS WITH CONTINUING DAMAGING WIND POTENTIAL ARE MOVING OUT OF WATCH 379 AND INTO WATCH 380.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: WRN SEGMENT OF LONG-LIVED MCS CONVECTION WILL MOVE FROM WATCH 379 TO WATCH 380 ACROSS SRN LA IN THE NEXT HOUR. REMAINING PORTIONS OF WATCH 379 CAN BE CANCELED PRIOR TO EXPIRATION. ..CARBIN.. 06/12/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS SPREADING SEWD FROM PORTIONS OF NWRN TX MAY POSE AN INCREASING THREAT FOR SEVERE WEATHER LATER THIS MORNING AND INTO THE AFTERNOON. A SEVERE TSTM WATCH MAY BE REQUIRED AHEAD OF THIS DEVELOPING CONVECTION.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TSTMS NOW MOVING ACROSS NWRN TX AND SWRN OK HAVE PERSISTED THROUGH THE EARLY MORNING WITH RECENT INCREASE IN LIGHTNING AND REFLECTIVITY OCCURRING WITH THE STORM MOVING THROUGH BAYLOR COUNTY. THIS CONVECTION APPEARS TO HAVE INITIATED OVERNIGHT ACROSS ERN NM AS A SUBTLE MID LEVEL SHORT WAVE TROUGH DEVELOPED EWD FROM THE FOUR CORNERS AREA. ISENTROPIC LIFT ACROSS DEEP-LAYER FRONTAL ZONE SITUATED ACROSS NRN TX/SRN OK ALSO APPEARS TO BE PLAYING A ROLE IN SUSTAINING THE CONVECTION. AIR PARCEL TRAJECTORIES FEEDING THIS ACTIVITY ORIGINATE IN A VERY UNSTABLE REGIME PARTIALLY REPRESENTED BY MAF MORNING SOUNDING. WHILE STRONG CAPPING MAY BE INHIBITING MORE VIGOROUS UPDRAFTS IN THIS REGIME THIS MORNING...SOME GUIDANCE SUCH AS NSSL WRF-ARW...APPEAR TO MAINTAIN A CLUSTER OF STORMS IN THE FORM OF A SMALL MCS MOVING SEWD THROUGH THE DAY. IF THIS SCENARIO UNFOLDS...THERE WILL BE AN INCREASING CHANCE FOR STORMS TO BECOME ROOTED IN THE DOWNSTREAM DESTABILIZING AIR MASS THAT WILL EXIST ACROSS NCNTRL TX. WIND DAMAGE AND LARGE HAIL THREATS COULD THEREFORE EVOLVE AND WARRANT A WATCH ACROSS THESE AREAS IN THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS. FARTHER NORTH INTO OK...LESS INSTABILITY BUT WEAKER INHIBITION AND MID LEVEL FLOW MAY ALLOW FOR MARGINAL SEVERE STORM POTENTIAL TO EVOLVE WITH TIME. HOWEVER...THESE LIMITATIONS MAY PRECLUDE THE NEED FOR A WATCH NORTH OF THE RED RIVER.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE THREAT FOR ISOLATED STRONG WINDS AND SOME HAIL WILL PERSIST ACROSS VALID PORTIONS OF THE WATCH AREA.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LOOSELY ORGANIZED LINEAR CONVECTIVE SYSTEM CONTINUES TO SPREAD SOUTH INTO SWRN LA AND EXTREME ERN TX EARLY THIS AFTERNOON. STRONG INSTABILITY HAS DEVELOPED ALONG THE SWN FLANK OF THE SYSTEM WHERE RECENT INCREASE IN CONVECTIVE VIGOR HAS BEEN NOTED OVER TYLER COUNTY TX. ELSEWHERE...STORMS HAVE BECOME OUTFLOW DOMINANT ACROSS SWRN LA WHERE WIND SHIFT HAS TRACKED SOUTH AT ABOUT 26KT AHEAD OF THE DEEPER CONVECTION TO ITS NORTH. OVERALL...SEVERE THREATS IN THE FORMS OF HAIL/WIND OF WILL PROBABLY REMAIN QUITE ISOLATED FOR THE REMAINDER OF THE WATCH VALID TIME. LOCAL HEAVY RAIN IS CERTAINLY A CONCERN GIVEN SLOW MOVEMENT AND TRAINING OF STORMS IN A VERY MOIST ENVIRONMENT. ..CARBIN.. 06/12/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SVR TSTM WATCH WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED ACROSS PORTIONS OF THE SRN HIGH PLAINS FOR THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING. THIS WATCH WILL BE COORDINATED WITH AFFECTED NWS WFOS SHORTLY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A BROAD BELT OF 30-40KT MID LEVEL WLY FLOW ACROSS THE MOUNTAINS ATOP INCREASING LOW LEVEL SLY/SELY FLOW ON THE WRN FLANK OF DEPARTING SURFACE ANTICYCLONE WILL SET UP A FAVORABLE WIND PROFILE FOR SUPERCELLS AND EVENTUALLY MORE ORGANIZED CONVECTIVE SYSTEMS ACROSS THE SRN HIGH PLAINS THROUGH LATE TODAY. FURTHER SUPPORT FOR TSTM DEVELOPMENT ACROSS THE REGION WILL EXIST IN THE FORM OF A QUASI-STATIONARY FRONTAL ZONE BACKED INTO THE HIGHER TERRAIN AND A LEE/THERMAL LOW AND WARM FRONT FORMING OVER SERN CO ATTM. AIR MASS ALONG AND EAST OF THESE FEATURES WILL CONTINUE TO DESTABILIZE AND SUPPORT MORE VIGOROUS DEVELOPMENT AND STORM SUSTENANCE AS CONVECTION SPREADS EAST FROM THE HIGHER TERRAIN OF RATON PASS IN NERN NM AND THE SANGRE DE CRISTO RANGE IN SERN NM. INITIAL STORMS MAY POSE A RISK OF LARGE HAIL AND HIGH WINDS AND WITH TIME EXPECT THIS ACTIVITY TO MERGE INTO ONE OR MORE STORM COMPLEXES THAT SHOULD CONTINUE TO SPREAD GENERALLY EWD/ESEWD ACROSS THE INSTABILITY AXIS SITUATED FROM W TX NWD TO WRN KS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED THREAT FOR HAIL AND DMGG WIND GUSTS MAY DEVELOP THIS AFTERNOON ACROSS PARTS OF THE CNTRL HIGH PLAINS. CONVECTIVE TRENDS ARE BEING MONITORED FOR A POSSIBLE WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: WATER VAPOR LOOP SHOWS A SHORTWAVE UPPER TROUGH TRAVERSING EWD ACROSS WY AND TOWARDS THE CNTRL HIGH PLAINS. INCREASING ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH THIS FEATURE...ALONG WITH STRONG DAYTIME HEATING IN THE WAKE OF EARLIER ELEVATED CONVECTION...AND WEAK CONVERGENCE ALONG A LEE SFC TROUGH...HAVE CONTRIBUTED TO THE DEVELOPMENT OF SEVERAL AREAS OF CU. ADDITIONAL DEVELOPMENT IS OCCURRING OVER THE BLACK HILLS OF SWRN SD...LIKELY ENHANCED BY WEAK UPSLOPE LOW-LEVEL FLOW COMPONENT IN RESPONSE TO SELY SFC WINDS. THESE AREAS WILL LIKELY SERVE AS THE FOCI FOR CONVECTIVE INITIATION WITHIN THE NEXT 1-2 HRS. SSELY BOUNDARY LAYER FLOW BENEATH STRONG MIDLEVEL SWLYS IS YIELDING 0-6 BULK SHEAR VALUES OF 40-50 KTS. PRIMARY FACTOR LIMITING A MORE ROBUST SVR THREAT WILL BE THE PRESENCE OF MEAGER LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE...WITH 19Z SFC OBS SHOWING SFC DEW POINTS IN THE LOW TO MID 40S ACROSS MOST OF THE HIGHLIGHTED AREA. HOWEVER...STRONG FORCING ACCOMPANYING THE UPSTREAM SHORTWAVE TROUGH...ALONG WITH A FAVORABLY SHEARED ENVIRONMENT AND STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES...SHOULD BE ENOUGH TO OVERCOME MOISTURE DEFICIENCIES AND STILL SUPPORT THE DEVELOPMENT OF STRONG TO ISOLATED SVR STORMS...CAPABLE OF PRODUCING HAIL AND ISOLATED DMGG WIND GUSTS. THE NEED FOR A WW IS STILL SOMEWHAT UNCERTAIN ATTM...BUT CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SOME POTENTIAL EXISTS FOR SEVERE STORM DEVELOPMENT ALONG AND NEAR AN OUTFLOW REINFORCED QUASI-STATIONARY FRONTAL BOUNDARY SITUATED SOUTH OF THE I20 CORRIDOR OF WEST TX THIS AFTERNOON. SOME OF THIS AREA MAY NEED TO BE COVERED IN A SEVERE TSTM WATCH BY LATE AFTERNOON IF CONVECTION CONTINUES TO DEVELOP WWD ALONG THE BOUNDARY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STRONG SURFACE HEATING AND PERSISTENT CONVERGENCE HAS ALLOWED CONVECTION TO BACKBUILD OUT OF WW381 AND WWD ALONG OUTFLOW REINFORCED QUASI-STATIONARY FRONTAL BOUNDARY SITUATED SOUTH OF I20 THIS AFTERNOON. VERY STRONG DESTABILIZATION WOULD SUPPORT ROBUST DEVELOPMENT. FURTHERMORE...SHEAR AND INSTABILITY REMAIN ADEQUATE FOR LARGE HAIL AND HIGH/DAMAGING WINDS WITH ANY PERSISTENT CELLS. WEAK RIDGING ALOFT AND POSSIBLE SUBSIDENCE IN THE WAKE OF THE IMPULSE DRIVING THE MCS FARTHER EAST ACROSS NCNTRL TX MAY ACT TO SUPPRESS MORE WIDESPREAD DEVELOPMENT. THUS...THERE REMAINS SOME UNCERTAINTY ON WHETHER A NEW WATCH IS NEEDED AT THIS TIME.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: DMGG WIND AND HAIL THREAT IS EXPECTED TO INCREASE THIS AFTERNOON ACROSS PARTS OF FAR W TX AND SERN NM. TRENDS ARE BEING MONITORED FOR A POSSIBLE WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CONVECTIVE INHIBITION APPEARS TO BE SLOWLY ERODING OVER PARTS OF W TX AS TEMPERATURES ARE HEATING INTO THE 90S. 20Z SFC ANALYSIS SHOWED A MODIFIED STATIONARY FRONT/OUTFLOW BOUNDARY BECOMING MORE DIFFUSE THIS AFTERNOON AS STRONG HEATING IS OCCURRING ON THE COOL SIDE...BUT A WEAK SFC WIND SHIFT IS STILL PRESENT. THE INITIAL CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT APPEARS TO BE FOCUSED ALONG TWO AREAS INITIALLY...1) OVER THE DAVIS MTNS...WHERE VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY AND SHOWS BUILDING CU FIELD...AND 2) ALONG/E OF THE SACRAMENTO MTNS IN S-CNTRL NM. E-SELY LOW-LEVEL FLOW COMPONENT IS ADVECTING RICHER MOISTURE FROM W-CNTRL TX INTO THE REGION...AND COMBINED WITH THE STRONG HEATING IS LIKELY YIELDING MLCAPE VALUES OF 1500-2000 J/KG. THIS IS ALSO ACTING TO ENHANCE DEEP-LAYER SHEAR...DESPITE MODEST MIDLEVEL FLOW IN PROXIMITY TO AN ANTICYCLONE CENTERED OVER NRN MEXICO. INITIAL CONVECTIVE MODES OF ORGANIZED SMALL CLUSTERS OR SUPERCELLS ARE EXPECTED...WITH AN ACCOMPANYING THREAT LARGE HAIL AND DMGG WINDS. CONVECTIVE TRENDS ARE BEING MONITORED FOR A POSSIBLE WW.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORM COMPLEX SOUTH OF DFW WILL CONTINUE TO TRANSLATE ESEWD OVER THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS AND MAY EVENTUALLY MERGE WITH SLOWER-MOVING CLUSTER OF STORMS ALONG SWRN FLANK OF RESIDUAL OUTFLOW BOUNDARY ACROSS SOUTHEAST TX.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: WIDESPREAD DEEP CONVECTION SOUTH OF DFW AREA HAS BEEN SLOW TO ORGANIZE THROUGH THE AFTERNOON AS AIR MASS TO ITS SOUTH HAS BECOME STRONGLY UNSTABLE. ANOTHER AREA OF STRONG TO OCCASIONALLY SEVERE STORMS PERSISTS ON THE FLANK OF A RESIDUAL OUTFLOW BOUNDARY TO THE NW OF HOUSTON. GIVEN MAGNITUDE OF AVAILABLE INSTABILITY /MLCAPE 2500-3000 J PER KG/ AND BELT OF 25-30KT MID LEVEL FLOW ACROSS THE REGION...EXPECT CONTINUING CHANCE OF HAIL AND LOCALLY STRONG WINDS. GREATER POTENTIAL FOR MORE WIDESPREAD SEVERE WEATHER MAY EVOLVE AS STORMS BEGIN TO MERGE AND COLD POOL DEEPENS ACROSS THE SERN PORTION OF THE WATCH LATER THIS AFTERNOON OR EARLY EVENING. ..CARBIN.. 06/12/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED SEVERE HAIL AND GUSTY WINDS MAY BE NOTED WITH STORMS THIS EVENING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST VIS IMAGERY SUGGESTS HEALTHY UPDRAFTS ARE ASSOCIATED WITH CONVECTION THAT EXTENDS ACROSS NERN NM INTO SERN CO. THIS ACTIVITY IS DEVELOPING WITHIN UPSLOPE REGIONS OF RETURN FLOW ALONG NRN PLUME OF SRN HIGH PLAINS INSTABILITY AXIS. WITH LLJ EXPECTED TO HOLD ACROSS THE HIGH PLAINS SHEAR PROFILES FAVOR SLOW SEWD PROPAGATING STORMS CAPABLE OF PRODUCING LARGE HAIL AT TIMES...ALONG WITH GUSTY WINDS. THESE STORMS SHOULD STRUGGLE TO MAINTAIN INTENSITY AS THEY MOVE TOWARD LOWER ELEVATIONS. ..DARROW.. 06/12/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: CONVECTION HAS OVERTURNED MUCH OF THE AIR MASS ACROSS WW 384...EXCEPT FOR THE SRN EXTENT /GENERALLY ALONG AND W OF A LINE FROM WRN WASHINGTON TO WHARTON COUNTIES/ WHICH CONTINUES TO HAVE A THREAT FOR SOME SEVERE WEATHER /PRIMARILY STRONGER WIND GUSTS/.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TRENDS IN REGIONAL RADAR IMAGERY SHOWED TWO STORM CLUSTERS MERGED OVER ROBERTSON COUNTY BETWEEN 2230-23Z...WITH ALL TSTMS HAVING WEAKENED SINCE THEN...EXCEPT FOR A SHORT SSEWD MOVING LINE SEGMENT CURRENTLY LOCATED OVER GONZALES-FAYETTE COUNTIES. AN INSTABILITY GRADIENT EXTENDING SWD FROM THIS LINE SUGGESTS THIS ACTIVITY SHOULD PROGRESS MORE SWD WITH TIME. HOWEVER...WITH A LACK OF FAVORABLE INFLOW INTO THIS LINE OF STORMS...THE OVERALL INTENSITY SHOULD REMAIN LOW AND THE CURRENT MOVEMENT AT 25 KT IS NOT FAVORABLE FOR PRODUCING SVR WIND GUSTS. THESE FACTORS SUGGEST THE REMAINING PORTION OF WW 384 COULD BE CANCELLED WELL BEFORE THE SCHEDULED 03Z EXPIRATION TIME. AND...GIVEN THE LIMITED SVR WEATHER THREAT WITH THE ONGOING STORMS...A NEW WW IS NOT NEEDED TO THE SW-S OF WW 384. ..PETERS.. 06/13/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE THREAT PERSISTS ACROSS THE SRN HIGH PLAINS THIS EVENING...ESPECIALLY ACROSS SERN NM INTO THE PERMIAN BASIN OF WEST TX.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SEVERAL STORM CLUSTERS...WITH ISOLATED SUPERCELLS...HAVE EVOLVED ACROSS THE SRN HIGH PLAINS FROM SERN NM TO NEAR MAF. THIS ACTIVITY INITIATED WITHIN UPSLOPE REGIONS WHERE STRONG HEATING CONTRIBUTED TO AIRMASS DESTABILIZATION. 00Z SOUNDING FROM MAF APPEARED TO SAMPLE ENVIRONMENT JUST WEST OF OUTFLOW PER STEEP LOW LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND MID 50S DEW POINTS. THIS SOUNDING SUPPORTS SUPERCELL STRUCTURES THAT WILL LIKELY PROPAGATE SLOWLY EWD...ESPECIALLY GIVEN THAT A SEGMENT OF THE LLJ SHOULD INCREASE ACROSS THE PERMIAN BASIN INTO SERN NM OVER THE NEXT NEW HOURS. WITH INCREASING SHEAR ALONG WWD MOVING OUTFLOW BOUNDARY IT WOULD SEEM THESE STORMS WILL EXPERIENCE SOME LONGEVITY AND PERSIST WELL AFTER DARK. LARGE HAIL REMAINS THE PRIMARY SEVERE THREAT. ..DARROW.. 06/13/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: NEW SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH IS NEEDED FOR PORTIONS OF THE HIGH PLAINS OF NWRN TX.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MULTIPLE STORM CLUSTERS ARE PROPAGATING ACROSS THE HIGH PLAINS OF NWRN-WEST TX. LARGE HAIL MAY ACCOMPANY THIS ACTIVITY AND A NEW WW WILL BE ISSUED SOON.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: LARGE HAIL IS THE PRIMARY SEVERE THREAT WITH MULTIPLE THUNDERSTORM CLUSTERS ACROSS THE SRN HIGH PLAINS OF WEST TX.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SW-NE ORIENTED MCS HAS EVOLVED ACROSS THE TX PANHANDLE LATE THIS EVENING. THIS COMPLEX OF STORMS HAS SLOWLY EXPANDED IN AREAL COVERAGE AND IS PROGRESSING SEWD AT ROUGHLY 20-25KT. GREATEST THREAT WITH THIS ACTIVITY SHOULD BE LARGE HAIL BUT IF FORWARD SPEED INCREASES THEN DAMAGING WINDS MAY BECOME MORE COMMON. JUST AHEAD OF THIS MCS A LONE SEVERE SUPERCELL IS DRIFTING SSEWD ACROSS ROOSEVELT COUNTY NM. THIS STORM HAS TRENDED DOWN OVER THE LAST HOUR AND WHILE HAIL MAY CONTINUE TO BE NOTED...WITH TIME...A SLIGHT TURN TO THE EAST MAY BE NOTED WHICH WILL TAKE THIS ACTIVITY INTO THE WRN PORTIONS OF WW 385. FARTHER SOUTH...OLD OUTFLOW BOUNDARY THAT IS DRAPED ACROSS THE PERMIAN BASIN SHOULD SERVE TO FOCUS A SLOW MOVING MCS AS IT SPREADS ACROSS THE MAF AREA TOWARD SERN PORTIONS OF WW. WITH SELY LLJ DIRECTED INTO THE SRN HALF OF THE WW IT APPEARS STORMS WILL PERSIST ACROSS THIS REGION WELL INTO THE EARLY MORNING HOURS. ..DARROW.. 06/13/2012
